title: Rajwada Palace, Indore - A Timeless Symbol of Holkar Royalty
content:
Rajwada Palace, Indore

Rajwada Palace is one of Indore’s most iconic landmarks and a magnificent reminder of the grandeur of the Holkar dynasty. Located in the heart of the old city near bustling markets, this seven-storey palace beautifully blends Maratha, Mughal, and French architectural styles, making it one of the most visually striking heritage structures in Madhya Pradesh.

Built by Malhar Rao Holkar around 1747, Rajwada is not just a royal residence-it is the historical soul of Indore. The palace complex includes a massive wooden entrance, beautiful jharokhas, arched gateways, courtyards, and a lush garden that has been restored with fountains and sculptures. Every corner tells a story of Indore’s royal past.

Why Visit Rajwada Palace?

1. Stunning Architecture: Rajwada’s unique seven-storey structure, stone-lower floors, and wooden upper floors create a dramatic combination rarely seen in India.

2. Light & Sound Show: Every evening, Rajwada hosts a captivating show that narrates the history of the Holkar dynasty with voice, visuals, and music.

3. Heritage Vibes: Surrounded by local markets, old streets, and traditional shops, Rajwada gives you a perfect glimpse of Indore’s old-world charm.

4. Rajwada Garden: A peaceful landscaped garden with fountains, ideal for photography and quiet relaxation.

Visiting Information

  • Timings: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM
  • Entry Fee: ₹10 - ₹20 approx.
  • Light & Sound Show: Evening (timings may vary by season)
  • Location: Rajwada Square, Old Indore
  • Best Time to Visit: October to March

faqs.question: Why is Rajwada Palace famous for?
faqs.answer: It is known for its seven-storey architecture and its deep connection to the Holkar royal family.

faqs.question: How old is Rajwada Palace?

faqs.question: How much time is needed to visit Rajwada?
faqs.answer: About 1-1.5 hours is enough to explore the palace and gardens.
